verdict.rationale: Scheduled or recurring workflows are a plausible capability for a risk-management SaaS platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes scheduling recurring jobs. The Referrals API (adyen-risk-docs-13) and webhooks (adyen-risk-docs-18) support API-driven and event-driven automation, not time-based recurring schedules, so they do not count toward this story.
